statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds an entry whose vendor or product field identifies Adobe Commerce or Magento, with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-08 and 2026-10-09.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV JSON feed, fetched on the deadline, contains at least one entry with vendorProject or product matching Adobe Commerce or Magento and dateAdded between 2026-09-08 and 2026-10-09 inclusive; else false.
failure_condition: As of the deadline the KEV catalog contains no Adobe Commerce or Magento entry with dateAdded on or after 2026-09-08 and on or before 2026-10-09.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds an entry for the SAP kernel vulnerability publicly designated OVERPASS, with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-08 and 2026-12-08.
